fields.factors: One entry per banded column; each reads one input column and writes one new output column. Several factors in one node band several columns.
fields.factors[].banding: "breakpoints" for a number or date column, "categorical" for a string column. There is no default type.
fields.factors[].outputColumn: The new column the band labels go to; it must not already exist.
fields.factors[].rules (breakpoints): Ordered {boundary, label} rows. Each boundary is a string holding the band's inclusive upper end: a number ("25") or a date ("2024-06-30"), all of one kind per factor. Bands are (previous boundary, boundary]. One last row with boundary "" is the open-ended band above the highest boundary; without it values above the highest boundary get the default.
fields.factors[].rules (categorical): {value, assignment} rows: value is the exact input string to match, assignment the band label. Values are strings even for codes that look numeric.
fields.factors[].default: The label for a value no rule matches, including null; null leaves those rows null.
fields.factors[].rightClosed: Optional, default true. false makes breakpoint bands [previous boundary, boundary) instead.

configs.name: minimal
configs.intent: Band driver age into three bands, the last open-ended.

configs.name: realistic
configs.intent: Band vehicle value, inception date and region code in one node.
